acceptance_criteria: Link.blob_id added. 4 new Link tests pass. cargo test -p jmap-calendars-types exits 0. Clippy clean.
close_reason: Added blob_id: Option<Id> to Link struct in jscalendar.rs; 4 new tests (link_with_href_roundtrip, link_with_blob_id_roundtrip, link_blob_id_absent_when_none, link_wire_names); 44 tests pass; clippy clean
description:
**What:** Add blob_id: Option<Id> to the Link struct in jscalendar.rs, and add the first tests for Link (which currently has zero test coverage).

**Algorithm:**
1. In crate-jmap-calendars-types/src/jscalendar.rs, add import at top: `use jmap_types::Id;` (alongside existing `use std::collections::HashMap;`).
2. Add field to Link struct after `display`:
```rust
/// JMAP blob id; may be set instead of `href` for server-stored attachments
/// (draft-ietf-jmap-calendars-26 §5.3 / §10.9.14).
///
/// When present, `href` may be absent.  The server MUST translate this to
/// an embedded data: URL when sending to systems that cannot access blobs.
#[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
pub blob_id: Option<Id>,
```
3. In tests/types_test.rs, add Link to the import list and add 4 tests:

**Test A: link_with_href_roundtrip**
- JSON: {"@type":"Link","href":"https://example.com/file.pdf","contentType":"application/pdf","size":4096,"rel":"enclosure","display":"report.pdf"}
- Assert each field. Verify blobId absent from serialized output.
- Oracle: RFC 8984 §1.4.11 field definitions.

**Test B: link_with_blob_id_roundtrip**
- JSON: {"@type":"Link","blobId":"blob-abc123","contentType":"image/png","size":2048,"rel":"enclosure"}
- Assert blob_id==Some(Id::from("blob-abc123")), href==None.
- Verify serialized output contains "blobId":"blob-abc123" and does NOT contain "href".
- Oracle: draft-ietf-jmap-calendars-26 §5.3 — blobId may be set instead of href.

**Test C: link_blob_id_absent_when_none**
- Construct Link with only @type and href set; serialize; assert "blobId" key absent.
- Oracle: skip_serializing_if = None — optional field absent when not set.

**Test D: link_wire_names**
- Deserialize JSON with all known fields; re-serialize; assert camelCase wire keys
  (blobId, contentType, rel, display — NOT blob_id, content_type etc.).
- Oracle: #[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")] on Link struct.

4. Run: cargo test -p jmap-calendars-types
5. Run: cargo clippy -p jmap-calendars-types -- -D warnings

**Defensive programming rules:**
- No unwrap(); use .expect("descriptive message") in tests
- Import added as `use jmap_types::Id;` (Pattern A, consistent with event.rs/calendar.rs)
- blobId is optional (skip_serializing_if) — spec says clients "may" set it; it is not required-nullable

**Acceptance criteria:**
- Link struct has blob_id: Option<Id> with wire name "blobId"
- 4 tests pass; no existing test regresses
- cargo test -p jmap-calendars-types exits 0
- Clippy clean.
title: Add Link.blob_id field and Link tests
